title: Hymns from the Land of Luther
author: borthwick
attributionNote: Recorded in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library under Jane Borthwick (1813-1897). The site catalogues the work at https://ccel.org/ccel/borthwick/hll, whose own card names the print edition transcribed here; where the site carries a title by a publisher's permission rather than in public domain, this library does not take it.
description: Hymns from the Land of Luther — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Hymns shelf. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition New York: Anson D. F. Randolph, 1866. (apparently following the 1858 London edition).
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 71 chapter(s), 3322 paragraph(s), 20,581 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.

texts.2.3: A few of the following poems may be considered as rather imitations than as translations, although the ideas and structures are too much borrowed to allow them to be called original. It is hoped that this small selection may give pleasure to some who are not acquainted with the German language, and lead others to explore further for themselves the treasures of devotional poetry.
